Class XMLArchiver

java.lang.Object
common.xml.XMLArchiver
All Implemented Interfaces:
GuiXMLConstants
public class XMLArchiver extends Object implements GuiXMLConstants

Title: XML Archiver

Description: Used to save and load model information to be used for the simulation and for the save/load capability.

Author:
Bertoli Marco Date: 22-lug-2005 Time: 13.47.51
